blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍CommerceGen-Studio,这是为电子商务股生成商业级主要图像的端到端框架。 我们的框架是按照信息提取、语义重写和多条件生成的三阶段管道组成的:即时-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent(PERL-Agent)通过一个无参考值的VLM和LLM角色的迭接闭环,将各种SKU元数据提炼成简明的销售点文本列表。 布局思维器优化(LTO)通过交替的域特定政策优化,使重写与标题和渲染图像质量一致. SKU-DIT,在强化-Distill-Reinforce(RDR)进步培训下培训,共同具备白底产品形象,商标作物等条件,结构化布局,以保持主体忠诚,商标完整性,以及字符级文本精准性. 这个框架每天以数百万个主要图像的规模在生产中运行,每个图像的延迟时间为几秒钟,我们认为,这使它成为最早在商业规模上运作的这类系统之一。 我们还发布了CommercialGen-Bench,这是从所有产品类别现场流量中收集的硬病例的基准. 就此而言,我们的框架在两个编辑轨道上,无论是否迅速改进,在评估的开源基线中,总得分最高。 它还匹配了更大的闭源模型,并在"指令跟随"和"产品集成"中击败了其中的几个——这两个属性决定一个图像是否可以发布.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: On e-commerce search result pages (SRPs), shoppers judge relevance almost entirely from two signals: the product image and the title. As search engines increasingly resolve a query to one specific Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) rather than to an item containing multiple SKUs, the SRP has to render display assets at the precise SKU granularity rather than the coarser item granularity. Merchants, however, rarely maintain them. SKU-level imagery is dominated by plain white-background product photographs, and dropping such photographs directly into the SRP measurably lowers click-through rate. Therefore, automated production of high-quality main images at SKU granularity is both a critical need for experience optimization and an inevitable choice for supply gap remediation.
blocks.zh: 在电子商务搜索结果页上,购买者几乎完全从两个信号判断相关性:产品图像和标题。 由于搜索引擎越来越多地解决向一个特定库存股(SKU)而不是向一个包含多个SKU的物品的查询,SRP必须在精确的SKU颗粒度上提供显示资产,而不是同位素颗粒度. 然而,商家很少保留这些商品。 SKU级图像以平地白底产品相片为主,将此类相片直接投入SRP可衡量地降低点击率. 因此,在SKU颗粒地自动制作高质量的主要图像,既是优化经验的迫切需要,也是弥补供应缺口的必然选择。

blocks.en: General-purpose text-to-image and image-to-image foundation models have advanced rapidly Hu et al. (2026a) ; Hu et al. (2026b) ; Chen et al. (2024c) ; Wu et al. (2025) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2026) ; Qiao et al. (2026) ; Black Forest Labs (2025) ; Liu et al. (2026b) , yet deploying them for SKU product cards exposes four requirements they were not designed to meet. First, selling points must be constructed from heterogeneous sources. SKU information is scattered across titles, OCR results from product images, structured attributes, and backend parameters. These sources may overlap, conflict, or be incomplete, and the relevant information varies by category. They must therefore be reconciled into a concise and reliable set of selling points before generation begins. Second, information consistency is essential: subjects, trademarks, and selling-point text must match the source SKU metadata exactly, since even a hallucinated digit or conflicting attribute may mislead a purchase decision. Third, long-tail robustness is required because live traffic spans diverse product categories and merchant images of highly uneven quality. Fourth, multi-condition layout control must jointly coordinate the product, trademark, and selling-point text within a coherent composition. Existing methods address these requirements only partially: cascaded “plan-then-render” systems accumulate errors across stages, while end-to-end poster models often trade text accuracy against

blocks.en:
We address these requirements with a system designed end to end rather than assembled from independently tuned parts. Our contributions are as follows. (1) We present CommerceGen-Studio, a fully automated production framework organized around three stages – information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation – that turns heterogeneous SKU metadata into executable
layout semantics and renders it with a single multi-image editing Diffusion Transformer (DiT). (2) We present Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent), which recasts selling-point extraction as an iterative closed loop over four roles (Generator, Judge, Analyzer, and Refiner; one VLM and three LLMs) scored by a six-dimensional reference-free rubric. One category-adaptive prompt serves every category, and attribution over the dominant failure dimension lets the loop roll back to a specific weakness instead of restarting.
(3) We present Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO), a VLM layout rewriter trained on two independently sampled reward domains – one scoring captions directly and one scoring rendered images. Rewards are normalized within each domain’s rollout groups, the two policy losses are computed separately, and each optimization step samples one reward domain for backpropagation according to the configured domain probability. (4) We present SKU-DiT together with Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, which sequences preference alignment, Dynamic Backward Simulation Distillation, and a second round of reinforcement on the few-step student, reaching a few seconds latency without conceding the text precision and subject fidelity earned earlier. (5) We release CommerceGen-Bench, a hard-sample benchmark spanning all e-commerce categories, with a five-dimensional rubric scored by a multimodal judge model so that results on it are reproducible across systems.

blocks.en: Recent e-commerce poster systems have moved beyond fixed templates toward learned composition and text rendering. PosterMaker Gao et al. (2025) and PosterCraft Chen et al. (2025) generate complete posters with accurate or stylized typography, but PosterCraft starts from a text prompt rather than a product reference, while PosterMaker does not address heterogeneous SKU metadata or separate trademark conditioning. Among 2026 systems, InnoAds-Composer Qin et al. (2026) jointly conditions on a subject image, a glyph image, and a style reference, yet receives the text and approximate placement as conditions instead of extracting selling points or planning a complex layout. AutoPP Fan et al. (2026) predicts background, selected copy, and layout from one product image and a supplied candidate-copy set, then optimizes the design model with online click feedback; it selects from prepared copy rather than reconciling raw titles, OCR, attributes, and parameters, and it has no separate trademark reference. PosterVerse Liu et al. (2026a) converts a user request into a blueprint and editable HTML poster with scalable typography, but its interface is prompt-driven and does not preserve multiple SKU reference assets. PosterText Liu et al. (2026b) unifies poster creation and editing by treating text patches as atomic units; it accepts one primary product image or poster together with an optional set of reference patches, but does not extract selling points from heterogeneous SKU sources or provide a metadata-driven adaptive layout planner. TransAnyText Liu et al. (2026c) localizes an existing e-commerce image by translating its text and generating an HTML patch whose position, font, color, and size adapt to the target language. Its documented inference input is a single source image, and its objective is localization rather than SKU-level selling-point construction or multi-reference product generation.
blocks.zh: 最近的电子商务海报系统已经从固定模板转向学习成份和文本渲染。 PosterMaker Gao等 (2025)和PosterCraft Chen等 (2025) 生成完整的海报,带有准确或分型的打字功能,但PosterCraft从文本提示而不是产品参考开始,而PosterMaker则不处理各种SKU元数据或单独的商标条件. 在2026个系统中,InnoAds-Composer Qin等(2026年)共同对主题图像,格子图像,样式参考设定条件,然而却收到文本并大致作为条件放置,而不是取出销售点或规划复杂的布局. AutoPP Fan等 (中文(简体) ). (2026年)从一个产品图像和一个提供候选拷贝的集中预测出背景,所选副本和布局,然后通过在线点击反馈来优化设计模型;它从已准备好的拷贝中选择,而不是调和原始标题,OCR,属性,参数,没有单独的商标参考. PosterVerse Liu等 (2026a) 将用户请求转换为蓝图并可以编辑带有可缩放打字功能的HTML海报,但其界面是即时驱动的,并不保留多个SKU参考资产. PosterText Liu等 (2026b)通过将文本补丁作为原子单位来统一海报的创建和编辑;它接受一款初级产品图像或海报并配有一组可选的参考补丁,但不会从多种SKU来源取出销售点或提供元数据驱动的适应性布局规划. 传输任意文本 Liu et al. (2026c)通过翻译已存在的电子商务图像并生成一个HTML补丁,其位置,字体,颜色,大小适应目标语言,将它本地化. 其有文献记载的推论输入是一个单一的源图像,其目标是本地化,而不是SKU级的销售点构建或多参考产品生成.

blocks.en: Reference-guided editing can transfer appearance from unconstrained visual exemplars Chen et al. (2024c) . Recent open-source image editors provide a stronger comparison for subject-preserving generation. LongCat-Image Ma et al. (2025) and the base JoyAI-Image-Edit interface Song et al. (2026) document a single source image, whereas JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus, FireRed-Image-Edit Qiao et al. (2026) , and FLUX.2 [klein] Black Forest Labs (2025) extend editing to multiple references. Qwen-Image Wu et al. (2025) supports precise editing and Chinese text rendering but does not document multi-reference conditioning in its technical report. These general editors nevertheless lack the upstream conversion of heterogeneous SKU metadata into verified selling points and a layout policy trained against the downstream generator. Their remaining domain-specific gaps are also visible on CommerceGen-Bench: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B/9B frequently fail on Chinese selling-point text, FireRed loses logos or fuses multiple product conditions unreliably, and Qwen-Image-Edit shows occasional product-identity drift. We state these as observations from our evaluation rather than as limitations claimed by the respective papers. CommerceGen-Studio addresses the full chain jointly: multi-source selling-point extraction, adaptive layout rewriting, dual-reference product-and-trademark conditioning, and character-level text fidelity.
blocks.zh: 参考指南编辑可以传输不受限制的视觉实例的外观 陈等 (2024c). 最近的开源图像编辑器为主题保存生成提供了更强的比较. LongCat-Image Ma等 (2025)和Base JoyAI-Image-Edit接口 Song等 (2026)记录了单一源图像,而JoyAI-Image-Edit-Plus,FireRed-Image-Edit Qiao等 (2026),和FLUX.2 [克林]黑森林实验室 (2025)则将编辑扩展为多处引用. Quen-Image Wu等 (2025)支持精确编辑和中文本渲染,但不在其技术报告中记录多参考条件. 然而,这些总编辑缺乏将各种SKU元数据上游转换成经核实的销售点以及针对下游发电机的布局政策。 在CommerceGen-Bench上也可以看到他们的剩余域名漏洞:FLUX.2 [klein] 4B/9B在中文发售点文本上经常出故障,FireRed失去标志或导出多条产品条件,而Quen-Image-Edit显示偶尔出现产品识别漂移. 我们说这些是我们评价中的意见,而不是各自文件所声称的限制。 CommerceGen-Studio共同解决了全链:多源销售点取出,适应性布局重写,双参考产品和商标条件,以及字符级文本忠心.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual Text Rendering
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉文本渲染

blocks.en: Diffusion models have long suffered from missing characters, incorrect characters, and character hallucinations in the accurate rendering of complex glyphs. AnyText and AnyText2 Tuo et al. (2024b) ; Tuo et al. (2024a) enhance multilingual text rendering precision through glyph-aware conditioning, but treat text as an independent rendering target while neglecting the coordination among text, overall layout, subject, and trademark, and cannot guarantee that the product subject remains unaltered. TextDiffuser Chen et al. (2023) introduces character-level segmentation masks to guide per-character rendering, while its successor TextDiffuser-2 Chen et al. (2024b) relaxes this constraint by adopting line-level text regions and LLM-based layout planning for more flexible composition, but still targets single-image text rendering and lack multi-condition joint modeling with product subject and trademark. FLUX-Text Lan et al. (2025) uses a diffusion Transformer backbone to improve scene text editing but only supports single-image text editing, not multi-condition (white-background image + trademark image + text layout) joint generation. EasyText Lu et al. (2026) improves the controllability of multilingual rendering but is not designed for the information consistency needs of e-commerce scenarios and lacks trademark fidelity and product subject constraints. Our work treats text layout as an explicit condition path in multi-condition generation and jointly models it with subject and trademark within a unified diffusion Transformer, filling the above gaps.
blocks.zh: 传播模型长期以来在复杂格言的准确渲染中一直受到缺少人物,不正确的人物和人物幻觉等的困扰. AnyText和AnyText2 Tuo等人(2024b); 图奥等. (2024a)通过glyph-aware调制来增强多语种文本的精确性,但将文本作为独立的渲染目标,同时忽略了文本,整体布局,主题,商标之间的协调,无法保证产品主体保持不变. 文本编辑器 Chen等 (2023)引入了字符级分解口罩来指导每个字符的渲染,而其后继的TextDiffuser-2 Chen等 (2024b)则通过采用线级文本区和基于LLM的布局规划来放宽这一限制,以更灵活的构成,但仍以单像文本渲染为目标,并缺乏与产品主题和商标的多条件联合模型. FLUX-Text Lan等 (2025)使用扩散变形器骨干来改进场景文本编辑,但只支持单相图文本编辑,而非多条件(白-后相图+商标图像+文本布局)联合生成. EasyText Lu等人(2026年)提高了多语种渲染的可控性,但并非针对电子商务情景的信息一致性需要而设计的,缺乏商标忠诚和产品主题限制. 我们的工作将文字布局作为多条件生成的明显条件路径,在统一的传播变形器内与主体和商标共同进行模型化,填补上述空白.

blocks.en: Reconstruction losses defined at the pixel level say nothing about whether text is legible or a composition is attractive, which is why reinforcement learning has moved into the post-training of diffusion models. Diffusion Transformers and flow-matching objectives Peebles and Xie (2023) ; Esser et al. (2024) ; Lipman et al. (2023) form the backbone on which current generative systems are built. DDPO Black et al. (2024) applies policy gradients to diffusion post-training by treating denoising as a Markov decision process, where trajectories are sampled on-policy from the current policy and rewards are assigned at the final step. However, it requires per-step policy probability computation and is designed for stochastic diffusion sampling, making it not directly applicable to the deterministic ODE rollout of flow matching. GRPO Shao et al. (2024) replaces the learned value function of PPO Schulman et al. (2017) with in-group relative advantages; it was designed for language models and does not transfer directly to the continuous-time setting of diffusion and flow matching. Flow-GRPO Liu et al. (2025) and DanceGRPO Xue et al. (2025) adapt GRPO to flow-matching models and a unified visual generation framework respectively, but the former requires converting a deterministic ODE into a stochastic SDE to inject exploration and introduces additional approximation errors and is prone to reward hacking without KL regularization, and the latter suffers from task interference and seesaw effects in multi-task mixed training. DiffusionNFT Zheng et al. (2025) proposes an online reinforcement algorithm compatible with flow matching, performing online reward optimization directly through the diffusion forward process without offline trajectory collection and with stable training; therefore, we adopt it as our policy optimization framework. DiffusionOPD Li et al. (2026) provides a diffusion-specific framework for on-policy capability integration: task-specialized teachers are trained independently, while the current student generates its own diffusion trajectories and is distilled toward the corresponding teacher on the states it actually visits. This separates capability-specific exploration from joint integration and reduces interference between heterogeneous objectives.

blocks.en: For inference acceleration, DMD Yin et al. (2024b) pioneers distribution matching distillation by compressing multi-step sampling to a single step, but single-step distillation yields limited generation quality in complex scenarios. DMD2 Yin et al. (2024a) raises few-step quality by refining the distribution matching strategy and adding backward simulation, but does not explicitly protect structural integrity. Based on DMD2, we propose Dynamic Backward Simulation Distillation, which increases the probability of stopping at timesteps near the clean-image endpoint to maintain structural integrity while enhancing generation quality, and introduces discriminator-based adversarial training to strengthen trademark generation, thus balancing quality and latency.
blocks.zh: 关于推论加速, DMD Yin等 (2024b)通过将多步采样压缩到单步来进行配分蒸馏,但单步蒸馏在复杂情景下产生有限生成质量. DMD2 导弹 殷等编. (2024a)通过完善发行配比策略并添加后向模拟,提高很少步质量,但没有明确保护结构完整性. 基于DMD2,我们提出"动态后向模拟分解"(Dynamic Backward Simulation Distillation),这增加了在清洁图像端点附近分时停止的可能性以保持结构完整性并同时提高生成质量,并引入基于歧视的对抗性训练来强化商标生成,从而平衡质量和耐久性.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: CommerceGen-Studio comprises a training pipeline and an inference pipeline, both shown in Figure 2 . At inference the input is a single product ID. PERL-Agent extracts a structured selling-point text list (TextList) from that SKU’s multi-source metadata, and Layout Thinker rewrites the TextList into a layout caption. The text encoder encodes that caption, and SKU-DiT consumes it alongside the white-background product image and the trademark crop to synthesize the final image in one multi-image editing pass.

blocks.en: Training proceeds in three cascaded stages over our in-house Swift-Image 6B backbone Hu et al. (2026b) . Stage I moves the general backbone onto the e-commerce SKU distribution through pretraining and continual training. Stage II applies Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce to align the generator with human preference and cut inference cost. Stage III trains the VLM layout rewriter under Layout Thinker Optimization so that TextList and SKU-DiT meet through an explicit, executable layout rather than an implicit one.

blocks.en: An item is the parent product listing, and its item image is the listing-level main image; an SKU is a concrete purchasable variant under that item, represented by its own SKU image. For selling-point extraction, we collect and filter heterogeneous information from five sources: text recognized from the item image, text recognized from the SKU image, SKU properties (combining attributes and structured backend fields), the SKU title, and the SKU category. The item image often contains shipping offers and other promotional benefits, but its product attributes may conflict with the selected SKU. We therefore retain useful benefit information while filtering conflicting product facts. For example, if the item image says “iPhone 17” but the selected SKU image shows an iPhone 18, preserving “iPhone 17” would inject an incorrect selling point into generation. The other four sources are less likely to conflict with the selected SKU, but they are still heterogeneous and verbose; only information that attracts buyers or expresses the product’s core value should be retained. The conventional alternatives scale poorly: per-category CASE WHEN rules require someone to anticipate every category, and hand-maintained prompts give no way to attribute a regression to a cause or to roll back to a known-good state. We instead treat prompt construction as an optimization problem solved by a closed loop of VLM and LLM roles, scored by a six-dimensional reference-free rubric, with one category-adaptive prompt covering all categories (Figure 3 ). Appendix A.2 specifies the rubric, PERL-Bench-6.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stage I: Pretraining & Continual Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 第一阶段:预训和继续 培训

blocks.en: The generation backbone adopts our in-house Swift-Image 6B unified multi-image editing Diffusion Transformer Hu et al. (2026b) . We then run a further round of continual training on the SKU vertical domain. Starting from high-quality main images contributed by both premium and long-tail merchants, we recover white-background product images by matting and caption the difference between the white-background and original images, which yields triplets of the form (white-background image, prompt, ground truth). Candidates are filtered twice, by an in-house aesthetics model and by high-saturation color detection, then sampled in a balanced manner across leaf category, background scene type, and in-image text length as described in Section 4.2 . This stage uses approximately 4M product-domain T2I samples, 2.67M single-image I2I editing pairs, and 274K multi-image I2I editing pairs to move the general backbone onto the e-commerce SKU distribution and to stabilize multi-condition text rendering and subject fidelity.

blocks.en: 3.4 Stage II: Progressive Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce Training

blocks.en: Stage I provides SKU-DiT with general multi-condition generation capabilities, but its reconstruction objective does not directly optimize text accuracy, selling-point completeness, subject fidelity, or visual quality. To address these limitations, Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) consists of three phases: reinforcement learning aligns the model with human preferences, distillation reduces the number of sampling steps for faster inference, and post-distillation reinforcement recovers the visual details and fidelity lost during distillation. Human preferences rl combines DiffusionNFT-based specialist optimization and DiffusionOPD-based capability integration.

blocks.en: Phase II: Distillation. After specialist alignment and on-policy capability integration,the student model has acquired both complex-layout generation and subject-preservation capabilities, but still requires expensive multi-step sampling at every step. Dynamic Backward Simulation Distillation folds both costs into few-step inference. We build on DMD2 Yin et al. (2024a) and depart from it in three respects. In the training mixture, general editing data and trademark-domain editing data are combined at a 3:1 ratio; either source alone is worse, as general data underfits domain-specific fonts while trademark-only data yields poorly scaled type. In the sampling schedule, we raise the probability of terminating at timesteps near the clean-image endpoint, which preserves structural integrity that uniform stopping tends to erode, and we add a discriminator trained against high-quality ground-truth images so that trademark strokes are supervised adversarially rather than only in expectation. In the inputs, trademark reference crops are often only tens of pixels across, so we upsample them before conditioning to keep fine stroke detail recoverable. Together with CFG and few-step distillation, single-image latency falls to the 5-second level.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:蒸发。 在专家对接和政策能力整合后,学生模式既获得了复杂放电生成能力,也获得了主题保护能力,但仍需要花费昂贵的多步骤取样。 动态后向模拟 Distillation 将两种成本折叠成几步推论. 我们以DMD2 Yin等(2024a)为基础,从三个方面出发。 在培训混合体中,一般编辑数据和商标域编辑数据以3:1的比例合并;由于一般数据低于专用域字体,而仅商标数据得分的种类差,因此两者中任何一个来源都更糟。 在取样时间表中,我们提高在接近清洁成像端点的分时终止的可能性,这维护了统一停止往往会侵蚀的结构完整性,我们又增加了一位经过高质量地面真实图像培训的歧视性人员,以便商标中风受到监督的对抗性而不是仅仅期望。 在投入中,商标参考作物往往只有几十个像素横跨,因此我们在调节前先取出它们来保持细微的中风细节可回收. 与CFG和几步分馏一起,单相相成后期降为5秒级.

blocks.en: Phase III: Post-Distillation Reinforcement. Distillation buys latency at the cost of a distribution shift, and the damage is not uniform: it concentrates in exactly the high-frequency detail we care most about, blunting font strokes and softening trademark edges. Rather than accept that as the price of speed, we run a second round of reinforcement directly on the few-step student, which re-establishes the subject fidelity and text precision learned during continual training and Phase I, but now under the few-step sampling constraint the student will actually face at inference. This phase uses roughly 2.5K grouped trajectories. The data is drawn from the same pool as continual training with tighter thresholds on aesthetics, composition, and OCR precision – a smaller and cleaner subset that sits closer to the online distribution than the broad training corpus does.
blocks.zh: 第三阶段:蒸发后 强化。 蒸发以发行量转移为代价购买了耐久性,而损坏并不统一:它集中了我们最关心的高频细节,钝化了字体中风和软化了商标边缘. 与其接受作为速度的代价,我们直接在几个步骤的学生身上进行第二轮强化,这重新确定了在持续训练和第一阶段期间所学的科目的忠诚和文字精度,但现在在几个步骤的抽样制约下,学生实际上将面临推断。 这个相相大约使用2.5K分组的轨迹. 数据来自与持续培训相同的集合,在美学、组成和OCR精度方面设置了更严格的门槛 — — 一个比广泛培训大纲更接近在线分布的更小更干净的子集。

blocks.en: 3.5 Stage III: Layout Thinker Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.5 第三阶段:布局思维优化

blocks.en: A TextList states what must appear in the image but not where or how, and feeding it to the generator directly forces the generator to invent its own layout, which is what makes composition unstable across samples. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) inserts an explicit rewriting layer between the TextList and generator (Figure 2 ). A VLM takes the TextList from PERL-Agent together with the white-background product image and, when available, the trademark crop, and emits a layout caption that decides subject position and orientation, background style and lighting, text hierarchy and color, and trademark position and size. Training proceeds in two stages, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). Unlike the reinforcement phases of the generator, which are LoRA-adapted Hu et al. (2022) , both rewriter stages fully fine-tune the upper transformer blocks while keeping the lower blocks frozen. The reason is that layout generation is not a matter of adopting a new output format—a change a low-rank adapter can absorb—but of changing how the model reads a product image: it must re-attend to the subject’s extent, saliency, and free space to decide where elements go. In our experiments, low-rank updates were too restrictive to capture this representational shift. The frozen lower blocks preserve the general visual-linguistic grounding from pretraining, and the trainable upper blocks specialize to layout reasoning.
blocks.zh: 一个"文本列表"(TextList)说明了在图像中必须出现什么,但不能在何地或何地出现,并将其输入生成器直接迫使生成器发明出自己的布局,这就使得各样本的成分不稳定. 布局思维器优化(LTO)在文本列表和生成器之间插入一个明确的重写层(图2 ). VLM从PERL-Agent中取出文本列表,加上白底产品图像,并在可用时出出商标收成,并出出一个布局标题,决定主题位置和取向,背景风格和照明,文本层次和颜色,以及商标位置和大小. 培训分两个阶段进行,监督微调(SFT),然后加强微调(RFT)。 与发电机的加固相(Lora-adapted Hu等 (2022))不同,两个重制相完全微调上层变压器区块,同时保持下层区块被冻结. 原因是布局生成并不是要采用新的输出格式——一种低等适配器可以吸收的改变——而是要改变模型读取产品图像的方式:它必须重新检查对象的程度、地位和自由空间,以决定元素流向何处。 在我们的实验中,低级更新的限制性太强,无法抓住这种代表性的转变. 被冻结的下行区块保留了一般的视觉-语言地平面,避免了预训,可受训练的上行区块专门进行布局推理.

blocks.en:
Our generation backbone is the in-house Swift-Image 6B unified multi-image editing DiT Hu et al. (2026b) . We initialize it from
the checkpoint obtained after the 500K-step foundational pretraining and 200K-step continual-training schedule reported in Swift-Image Hu et al. (2026b) . The data curriculum follows the capability-centric design of Wang et al. (2026) , which progressively increases the training resolution from 256 to 1024 pixels through a five-stage curriculum. We then adapt this checkpoint to the SKU domain using the stage-wise datasets summarized in Table 4 .

blocks.en: PERL-Agent uses two data stages. The cold-start stage contains 100 heterogeneous SKU records spanning the five information sources above. It is used to initialize the extraction prompt, expose cross-source conflicts, and establish rules for retaining important selling points. The same 100 records also calibrate the LLM Judge: after the cold-start extractor produces its first-round TextLists, the Judge and multiple domain experts score each result independently. We compute Spearman rank correlation Spearman (1904) between the sample ordering induced by the mean expert scores and that induced by the Judge scores. Spearman correlation does not require experts to annotate ranks manually; it converts the two sets of scalar scores into ranks and measures whether the Judge orders good and bad TextLists consistently with the experts. A Judge configuration enters the closed loop only when ρ > 0.7 \rho>0.7 , which serves as a screening threshold for sufficient ranking agreement with domain experts. After cold start and calibration, the scale-up stage expands directly to approximately 1,000 full-category records for prompt optimization and failure-pattern coverage.
blocks.zh: PERL-Agent使用两个数据相. 冷启动阶段包含100个不同SKU的记录,涵盖上述五个信息来源。 它用于初始化取出快取,揭露出出出相通源冲突,并确立保留出相重要的出相点的规则. 同样的100个记录也校正了LLM裁判:冷起取出后,裁判和多域专家产生出首轮"文本解说"(TextLists),每个结果独立得分. 我们计算斯皮尔曼对斯皮尔曼的排名(1904年) 在平均专家得分和法官得分的抽样订购之间。 斯皮尔曼关联不需要专家手动注释排名;它将两套分数转换为分数并衡量法官是否与专家一致地命令好坏的文本列表. 法官配置只有在 ^ > 0.7\rho>0.7 时才进入闭环,这可作为与域专家达成充分排名协议的筛选门槛。 在冷起步和校正后,扩能阶段直接扩展至约1000个完整类别记录,以迅速优化和失败模式覆盖.

blocks.en:
Average-case benchmarks do not adequately reflect model performance in real-world e-commerce scenarios, where difficult and long-tail cases are
particularly important. CommerceGen-Bench comprises 400 real online cases collected from live search result pages, evenly split into 200 single-image editing samples and 200 multi-image editing samples. The benchmark spans 6 top-level categories and 15 subcategories: 3C electronics and home appliances, home goods and home improvement, cosmetics and apparel, general merchandise, sports and maternity, and a residual category. A sample qualifies as hard when at least one of the following holds: the subject has thin or transparent structure that matting tends to destroy, the trademark is small enough that its strokes fall near the resolution limit, or the selling-point text is long enough that character-level errors become likely. Figure 5 gives the category distribution.

Recent benchmarks emphasize practical and reasoning-intensive single- and multi-image editing scenarios Zhou et al. (2026) . Following this evaluation setting, we use Gemini 3 Flash Google (2026) as the multimodal judge model to assess each generated image against its reference product image and editing instruction. To reduce the influence of input resolution, all
images are resized to approximately 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 before evaluation. Five dimensions are assessed on [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] . Product Fidelity (PF) asks whether the identity, structure, color, and key attributes of the core product match the reference. Instruction Following (IF) asks whether the requested edit was actually carried out. Product Integration (PI) asks whether the edited product sits plausibly in its new scene. Naturalness Detection (ND) measures overall realism and the consistency of lighting and materials. Artifacts Detection (AD) identifies blur, distortion, broken edges, and garbled text. Rendered text is verified throughout with PP-OCRv6 Zhang et al. (2026) , which supplies the OCR penalty in the Phase I reward.

PERL-Agent. PERL-Agent instantiates all four roles with Qwen3.8-27B Qwen Team (2026b) using role-specific prompts. The Generator

The Analyzer and Refiner also operate in text-only mode, attributing low scores to failure patterns and updating the extraction prompt, respectively. No model parameters are updated during the
PERL-Agent loop.The refinement loop runs for at most 10 rounds and terminates early when the aggregate rubric score does not improve for three consecutive rounds. In practice, the best score is typically reached within the first three rounds. After termination, we retain the prompt with the highest aggregate rubric score over all completed rounds.

blocks.en: Generator. SKU-DiT is trained as a chain in which each stage initializes from the converged weights of the previous one, and the training method alternates according to what the stage needs. Since transferring a general backbone onto the product distribution is a change of representation that a low-rank update cannot express, continual training on the SKU vertical domain updates all parameters of the Swift-Image 6B backbone Hu et al. (2026b) . When in RL Phase I, we train two LoRA-based specialist teachers with DiffusionNFT: a complex-layout teacher and a subject-preservation teacher, both using rank 32 and α = 64 \alpha=64 . Each teacher uses 8 rollout samples per group, 16 inference steps, and a guidance scale of 4.0. The OCR penalty weight in the reward is set to w = 0.4 w=0.4 in both reinforcement phases. After the two specialist teachers converge, their capabilities are integrated into a single student SKU-DiT through DiffusionOPD-based on-policy distillation. This student initializes the full-parameter few-step distillation in Phase II, because folding classifier-free guidance and a multi-step sampler into a few-step student alters the sampling behavior of the whole network rather than adjusting a preference. Phase III post-distillation reinforcement again uses LoRA over the distilled student at the same rank 32 and α = 64 \alpha=64 , with 8 rollout samples per group, 8 inference steps to match the student sampler, and a guidance scale of 1.0, guidance having already been distilled into the model by that point.
blocks.zh: 发电机。 SKU-DIT作为链式训练,每个阶段从前一个阶段的相接权重中初始化出一个链式,而培训方法根据阶段需要的替代. 由于将一般主干转移到产品分销上是低级更新无法表达的表达方式的改变,所以关于SKU垂直域的持续培训更新了Swift-Image 6B主干Hu等人(2026b)的所有参数. 在RL第一阶段,我们培训了两名以LORA为基础的专家教师,他们使用DifmusionNFT:一名复杂的教师和一名主题保护教师,他们都使用第32级和α=64\alpha=64。 每名教师使用每组8个推广样本,16个推断步骤,指导尺度为4.0. 奖励中OCR的罚分重量在两个加固阶段被设定为w=0.4 w=0.4. 在两位专家教师汇聚后,他们的能力通过基于政策分解的分解OPD被整合为单一学生SKU-DIT. 这个学生在第二阶段中初始化了全参数的"几步"蒸馏法,因为将无分解的指向和多步取样器折叠成"几步取样"的学生会改变整个网络的采样行为,而不是调整一个偏好. 第三阶段的分解后强化再次使用LORA来比同等级的分解生32和α = 64\alpha=64,每组有8个分解样本,8个推论步骤与学生取样器相匹配,而指导尺度为1.0,到此时导已分解入模型.

blocks.en: This alternation between full-parameter updates and low-rank adaptation follows a consistent principle: stages that must acquire or restructure capability update all parameters, whereas the two reward-driven stages are confined to a low-rank subspace. Restricting reinforcement in this way bounds how far reward optimization can pull the model from the grounding established by the preceding supervised or distillation stage, which is the failure mode we most needed to avoid: an unconstrained policy update that chases the aesthetic components of the reward will readily trade away the subject and text fidelity that the earlier stages installed.
blocks.zh: 完全参数更新和低等适应之间的这种交替遵循一个一致的原则:必须获得或重组能力更新所有参数的阶段,而两个奖励驱动的阶段仅限于低等子空间。 以这种方式限制强化会限制奖励优化能从前一个监督或提炼阶段建立的地基中拉出多远的模型,这是我们最需要避免的失败模式:一种追逐奖励的美学成分的不受约束的政策更新会轻易地将早期安装的主体和文本的忠诚性交换出去.

blocks.en: Layout rewriter. LTO uses Qwen3.8-27B Qwen Team (2026b) as its backbone. Its reinforcement stage is not LoRA-adapted as the generator’s is; instead both LTO stages train the upper transformer blocks in full while the lower blocks stay frozen, so that general visual-linguistic grounding is preserved while the upper blocks specialize to layout planning. Producing a layout requires reasoning jointly over the product image and the TextList to decide placement, hierarchy, and scale, and in our experiments a low-rank update did not give the upper blocks enough capacity to acquire that behavior; the same trainable parameter set is then carried into the RFT stage. In RFT, the two reward domains are activated uniformly at random, i.e., p text = 0.5 p_{\mathrm{text}}=0.5 , with each optimization step backpropagating through exactly one domain.
blocks.zh: 布局重写 。 LTO 使用 Quen3. 8-27B 键 Quen Team (2026b)作为它的骨干. 它的加固相没有像发电机那样适应LORA;相反,两个LTO相位都完全训练上变压器块而下变压器块会保持被冻结,这样一般的可视-语言地平面被保留,而上变压器则专门进行布局规划. 制作出一个布局需要共同对产品图像和TextList进行推理,以决定放置,分级和尺度,在我们实验中,一个低级更新并没有给予上层块足够的能力来获得这种行为;然后将同一可训练参数集被带入RFT阶段. 在RFT中,两个奖励域都是随机统一激活的,即p text = 0.5 p_{\-mathrm{text {0.5},每个优化步骤都通过精确一个域来回宣传.

blocks.en: Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We presented CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for producing commercial-grade main images at SKU granularity. Its three components address the four requirements we set out with: PERL-Agent extracts selling points from heterogeneous metadata under a reference-free rubric, Layout Thinker Optimization turns those selling points into layouts the generator can execute, and SKU-DiT trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce renders them with a latency of a few seconds without surrendering fidelity. On CommerceGen-Bench, our hard-sample benchmark, the framework achieves the highest Overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without PE, and remains competitive with leading closed-source systems, outperforming several of them on selected dimensions. Two limitations point to future work. First, our reward signals are defined by rubrics and therefore capture what we can articulate; incorporating real user behavior would let the model learn aesthetic preferences that resist explicit specification. Second, the system currently optimizes for a single notion of quality per SKU, and conditioning on audience segment and style would let one product yield genuinely different assets rather than one canonical treatment.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了CommerceGen-Studio,这是在SKU颗粒区制作商业级主要图像的端到端框架。 它的三个部分满足了我们提出的四项要求:PERL-Agent在无参考标题下从各种元数据中提取出销售点;布局思维优化将那些销售点转化为发电机可以执行的布局;在加强-Distill-Reinforce下训练的SKU-DIT使其在不忠的情况下有几秒钟的空闲时间。 在Bench商业方面,我们的硬样本基准,框架在两个编辑轨道上,无论有无PE,在评估的开源基线中,总得分最高,并且仍然与领先的封闭源码系统有竞争力,在选定的维度上优于其中几个。 未来工作有两个限制。 首先,我们的奖赏信号通过标题来定义,从而捕捉到我们能够表达的内容;纳入真正的用户行为将使模型能够学习抵制明确规格的审美偏好. 其次,该系统目前优化了每个SKU的单一质量概念,对受众部分和风格的限定将使一个产品产生真正不同的资产,而不是一种犬类处理。

blocks.en: When a relevant small detail or text is visibly unreadable, do not assume it is correct. Do not reward beauty, resolution, or style in dimensions where it does not prove correctness.
blocks.zh: 当相关的小细节或文本明显无法读取时,不要假设它是正确的. 在不证明正确的情况下,不要奖励美、解或风格。

blocks.en: Use the lower end of a band when several defects exist and the upper end when only one limited defect exists. When uncertain between two scores, choose the lower score.
blocks.zh: 当存在几个缺陷时,使用波段的下端;当只有一个有限缺陷时,使用上端. 当两个分数之间不确定时,选择较低的分数.

blocks.en: PF – Product Fidelity: identity, silhouette, geometry, proportions, materials, colors, fine details, original packaging text, trademarks, and product logos. Layout or camera changes alone are not fidelity errors.
blocks.zh: PF – 产品Fidelity:身份, silhouette,几何,比例,材料,颜色,细微细节,原始包装文本,商标,以及产品标志. 光是布局或相机改变就不是忠贞错误.

blocks.en: IF – Instruction Following: completion and correctness of every explicit requested edit, object, placement, count, relation, style, and newly added or modified text.
blocks.zh: IF – 指令以下:每个明确请求的编辑,对象,位置,计数,关系,样式以及新添加或修改的文本的完成和正确性.

blocks.en: PI – Product Integration: how coherently the preserved product and optional logo belong in the edited composition, including placement, scale, perspective, lighting, shadows, reflections, edges, occlusion, and scene interaction.
blocks.zh: PI — 产品集成:保存的产品和可选标志在被编辑的构成中如何一致,包括位置,尺度,视角,照明,阴影,反射,边缘,被隔离,和场景互动.

blocks.en: ND – Naturalness Detection: perceptual realism and visual plausibility appropriate to the requested photo, advertising, illustration, or graphic-design style. Judge anatomy, physics, texture, lighting, depth, typography placement, and composition, not mere attractiveness.
blocks.zh: ND – Naturalness Detection:与所请求的照片,广告,插画,或图形设计风格相适应的感知现实主义和视觉取向. 解剖学,物理,纹理,照明,深度,打字布置,以及组成,而不仅仅是吸引力.

blocks.en: AD – Artifacts Detection: absence of malformed geometry, duplicated or missing parts, garbled pixels or text, halos, seams, smearing, ghosting, unintended objects, broken edges, and generation residue. A higher score means fewer artifacts.
blocks.zh: AD – Artifacts 检测:没有畸形几何,重复或缺失的部件,被套上像素或文字,光圈,接合,涂抹,幽灵,出乎意料的物体,断缘,和生成后残留. 更高的分数意味着文物较少.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Forensic evaluation prompt for CommerceGen-Bench (abridged): a conservative five-dimensional rubric (PF, IF, PI, ND, AD) scored 0–10, where the overall score is the arithmetic mean of the five dimensions. Per-band anchor descriptions are omitted for space.
blocks.zh: 图8:为CommerceGen-Bench(简写出):一个保守的五维分(PF,IF,PI,ND,AD)得分为0–10分,其中总分为五维的算术平均值. 每段锚地描述被省略用于空间.

blocks.en: A.2 PERL-Bench-6
blocks.zh: A.2 PERL-Bench-6 号

blocks.en: The six-dimensional ground-truth-free rubric used to evaluate PERL-Agent’s TextList quality is defined as follows: Source Compliance (SC) measures the consistency between text information and SKU metadata; Expression Quality (EQ) measures the fluency and professionalism of language expression; Category Fitness (CF) measures how well the content matches category-specific characteristics; Red-line Check (RL) detects whether the content violates rules or contains sensitive material; Structure Compliance (ST) measures the structural regularity of the text list; Business Value (BV) measures the commercial conversion potential of selling-point information. Each dimension is scored from 0 to 1, and a rule module applies reverse penalty scoring for specific patterns. By default, an aggregate score ≤ 5 \leq 5 out of 6 is classified as a bad case, triggering Analyzer attribution and Refiner rollback.
blocks.zh: 用于评价PERL-Agent的文本列表质量的六维无地真道标则定义如下: 源遵守(SC)衡量文本信息与SKU元数据的一致性; 表达质量(EQ)衡量语言表达流利性和专业性; 适合类别(CF)衡量内容与特定类别特征的匹配程度; 红线检查(RL)检测内容是否违反规则或包含敏感材料; 结构遵守(ST)衡量文本列表的结构规律; 商业价值(BV)衡量销售点信息的商业转换潜力. 每个维度从0分到1分,一个规则模块对特定模式适用反向罚分. 默认情况下,总分QQ 5\leq 5在6分中被归类为坏事,引发了分析器归属和炼油机回滚.
